tools.name: bookingmood_get_organization
tools.description: The Bookingmood organization this API key belongs to: name, company, plan (tier, subscription type, expiry), languages, country, VAT number, custom domain and contact details. Payment-provider ids and secrets are not returned. GET /organizations.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_products
tools.description: List the rentable products (apartments, rooms, boats, bikes...) with name, currency, timezone, rent period (daily/nightly), booking interaction, fee and deposit. Names and descriptions are objects keyed by language ('default', 'nl-NL', ...). Images are not returned. GET /products.

tools.name: bookingmood_get_product
tools.description: One product by id with its capacities (guest-group min/max limits) embedded. GET /products?id=eq.{id}&select=*,capacities(*).

tools.name: bookingmood_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest first: reference, method (request or book), currency, confirmed_at (null = not confirmed yet), created_at. A booking's dates and guests are on its calendar events (bookingmood_list_calendar_events) and contacts. Filter by creation date, confirmation state or reference text. The

tools.name: bookingmood_get_booking
tools.description: One booking with everything attached: its calendar events (dates, product, status, occupancy, notes), line items, payments, invoices and the guest contacts linked to it. Five or six read requests. The guest contacts come from the booking-contact link table; if that lookup fails the reply says so ins

tools.name: bookingmood_list_calendar_events
tools.description: List calendar events: bookings (type 'booking'), blocked periods and notes, with product_id, booking_id, start_date, end_date, status (TENTATIVE, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED), occupancy, title and notes. Use the date filters for arrivals/departures (e.g. start_date_from = start_date_to = today lists today'

tools.name: bookingmood_check_availability
tools.description: Availability calendar of up to 5 products: per product a list of intervals {start, end, status} with status available, tentative, unavailable, booked or reserved. One request per product. GET /availability?product_id={id}.

tools.name: bookingmood_search_products
tools.description: Which products can be booked for a stay: for each product whether it matches the dates, guest numbers and options, its availability and a price range {min, max}. Read-only (a search; nothing is booked). occupancy maps a capacity-group id (from bookingmood_get_product capacities) to a number of guest

tools.name: bookingmood_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (guests and customers): name, email, phone, company, address, language, notes. Search by name, email or company (case-insensitive, contains). Newest first. GET /contacts.

tools.name: bookingmood_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id. GET /contacts?id=eq.{id}.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_payments
tools.description: List payments (deposits, balances, offline payments): booking_id, invoice_id, amount and paid (integers; the API reference does not state the unit, normally the smallest currency unit), currency, due_at, completed_at (null = not paid), status, offline. Filter to unpaid payments, a booking or a due d

tools.name: bookingmood_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices: reference, booking_id, attachment (a custom uploaded file URL, if any), created_at. Filter by booking or creation date. Newest first. GET /invoices.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_line_items
tools.description: List invoice/booking line items: name (per language), amount and quantity (integers; the API reference does not state the unit), item_type (rent, fee...), fee_type (fee or deposit), booking_id, event_id, invoice_id. GET /line_items.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons: code, description, definition, quota, scope (global, product, service, rent), stackable. Deleted coupons are left out. GET /coupons.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_services
tools.description: List services: the extras, fees and form fields guests can add to a booking, with label, type, fee, deposit and description. GET /services.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_tasks
tools.description: List housekeeping/operations tasks attached to calendar events: label, due_at, completed_at (null = open), schedule (manual, arrival, departure), calendar_event_id. Filter to open tasks or a due-date window. Earliest due first. GET /tasks.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_messages
tools.description: List the e-mails and SMS Bookingmood sent or scheduled to guests: subject, body, type (email or sms), status (sent, manually-scheduled, scheduled-around-arrival, scheduled-around-departure), send_at, booking_id. The rendered HTML is not returned. Latest first. GET /messages.

tools.name: bookingmood_update_event_notes
tools.description: WRITE: replace the internal notes of ONE calendar event (the whole notes text is overwritten, so include the existing text if you want to keep it - read it first with bookingmood_list_calendar_events). Notes are internal; no guest is notified. PATCH /calendar_events?id=eq.{id}.

tools.name: bookingmood_set_event_status
tools.description: WRITE: change the status of ONE calendar event to CONFIRMED, TENTATIVE or CANCELLED. This changes what the calendar shows as available and can trigger Bookingmood's own automations for the booking (guest e-mails, tasks, payment reminders), so confirm with the user before cancelling or confirming. PA

tools.name: bookingmood_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new contact (guest/customer) in Bookingmood. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two contacts, so search with bookingmood_list_contacts first. No message is sent to the contact. POST /contacts.

tools.name: bookingmood_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of ONE existing contact (only the fields you pass are changed; others stay). No message is sent to the contact. PATCH /contacts?id=eq.{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bookingmood_search_products, bookingmood_list_contacts, bookingmood_list_invoices, bookingmood_list_messages, bookingmood_create_contact · Private data: bookingmood_get_organization, bookingmood_list_bookings, bookingmood_get_booking, bookingmood_list_contacts, bookingmood_get_contact, bookingmood_list_invoices, bookingmood_create_contact, bookingmood_update_contact · Public sink: bookingmood_search_products, bookingmood_list_contacts, bookingmood_list_messages, bookingmood_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bookingmood_search_products, bookingmood_list_contacts, bookingmood_list_invoices, bookingmood_list_messages, bookingmood_create_contact · Private data: bookingmood_get_organization, bookingmood_list_bookings, bookingmood_get_booking, bookingmood_list_contacts, bookingmood_get_contact, bookingmood_list_invoices, bookingmood_create_contact, bookingmood_update_contact · Public sink: bookingmood_search_products, bookingmood_list_contacts, bookingmood_list_messages, bookingmood_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
